title: Nine Minutes on Two Phones
subtitle: 电影影像 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 电影影像（文学艺术与体育·电影与影像）
meta: 主题语境：电影影像（文学艺术与体育·电影与影像）　|　核心词汇：effect　|　正文 373 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 effect 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Nobody in our film club could afford a proper camera, so we shot our first film on two old phones. The ① effect of that decision lasted three years: with no equipment to hide behind, we spent a fortnight arguing about the script instead, and the story became better than any filter could have made it.

Light turned out to be everything. Late afternoon does half the work for you, and nobody ever says so. Rain had a curious ② effect on turnout: half of us stayed at home, and the other half shot the best footage we have ever had. Sound, too, has a strange effect — nobody notices it at all until it is wrong. Waiting, I decided, is a skill, and no class teaches it.

People talk about special ③ effects as if they were tricks to be bought. In our case the opposite was true. The moment audiences still mention — eleven seconds of a girl walking past a bus queue — cost us nothing. It works entirely because of what the previous shot put into their heads, and it worked by accident: we ran out of ideas and simply left the camera running.

My mother sells tickets at the town cinema and has watched attendance fall for eleven years. Streaming, she says, arrived ④ in effect overnight, and its ⑤ effect on a town like ours has been brutal: two screens became one, and then the doors closed. The new rule about late performances ⑥ takes effect next month, and she expects nobody to thank anyone for it.

Our film ran nine minutes and was seen, ⑦ in effect, by about sixty people, mostly out of politeness. One boy came up afterwards and said it ⑧ had the effect of making him notice that street differently. That one sentence repaid the whole term. ⑨ Cause and effect, I have since decided, are rarely neighbours: what we do sends out a thousand small ripples we never see, and the one somebody tells you about years later is worth all of it. Special effects, in other words, are cheaper in the head than in the edit. Nobody can ⑩ effect a change in a single afternoon, but a camera does make you look at things long enough to notice them.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （影视的）特效；效果（special effects）
C. v. 实现；促成（effect a change/reform）
D. 固定搭配：have an effect on 对……产生影响
E. 固定搭配：in effect 实际上；事实上
F. 固定搭配：take effect 开始生效；起作用
G. 固定搭配：cause and effect 因果关系
H. 固定搭配：have the effect of doing 产生……的结果

items.q: The effect of that decision lasted three years
Rain had a curious effect on turnout
its effect on a town like ours
was seen, in effect, by about sixty people
had the effect of making him notice
Cause and effect, I have since decided

answers.why: the effect of＋决定／行为，意为“……的影响”，此处说用旧手机拍摄这一决定的影响持续了三年。
have an effect on＋对象，意为“对……产生影响”，下雨影响了到场人数。
special effects 是影视术语，指“特效”，与后文“我们一分钱没花”形成对比。
in effect 意为“实际上”，修饰 overnight，说明流媒体几乎一夜之间到来。
its effect on a town 意为“它对小镇的影响”，仍是名词“影响”。
take effect 意为“生效”，指关于深夜场次的新规定下月实施。
同样是 in effect，意为“实际上”，说明观众其实只有六十来人。
have the effect of doing 意为“产生……的结果”，此处说这部片子让那个男孩开始换一种眼光看那条街。
cause and effect 是固定搭配，意为“因果”，作者感叹因果之间往往相隔很远。
effect＋宾语 a change，是动词“实现、促成”，与 change、reform 等名词连用。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 用两台旧手机拍摄这个决定的影响持续了三年。（effect n.）
下午的光线对一个镜头影响很大。（have an effect on）
我们当时没钱做任何特效。（special effects）
事实上，流媒体几乎是一夜之间到来的。（in effect）
关于深夜场次的新规定将于下月生效。（take effect）
观看这部影片使他开始用不同的眼光看待那条街。（have the effect of）
answers: The effect of shooting on two old phones lasted three years.
Late afternoon light has a great effect on a shot.
We had no money for any special effects.
The new rule about late performances takes effect next month.
Watching the film had the effect of making him see that street differently.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 effect 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Nobody in our club could afford a camera, and the effect of that decision lasted three years.
Light has a greater effect on a shot than any filter, and rain had a curious effect on who turned up.
We had no money for special effects, so the eleven seconds everybody remembers cost nothing at all.
Streaming arrived in effect overnight, and its effect on the town cinema has been brutal.
Watching our film had the effect of making one boy see a whole street differently.
Cause and effect are rarely neighbours: nobody can effect a real change in a single afternoon.
